content.title: Mechanism Design under Belief Disagreement: Allocation Flexibility and Rent Capacity
content.abstract: A seller jointly chooses allocation and payments when buyers misperceive competition. Under independent private values, statewise participation, and payment restrictions, allocation determines both required rents and their delivery capacity. We separate these effects under a common subjective law. For three values and shared-top beliefs, explicit score and capacity conditions characterize globally optimal lower-value lotteries, including top-rent overflow and welfare differences among revenue optima.
